text:
alex: quick heads-up — we observed sustained nvlink errors + thermal climb on rack-12 in us-west1 since 10:40. not severe yet but it's trending. i'm proposing a short midday pool reshard to spread GPU load off that rack and run a rolling pod handoff. will keep windows tiny (<=10m per node).

alex: rough plan:
- 12:15 start
- take 1 node at a time from pool-gpu-usw1-p1, cordon -> migrate pods -> uncordon
- per-node target: 8-10m (drain/evict backfill)
- fallback: if p95 latency > 350ms, abort and rollback routing to pool-gpu-usw1-p2

marie: product impact? any Dedicated customers affected?

alex: short answer: low. dedicated pools pinned by contracts won't be touched. this is only for our shared burst pool (pool-gpu-usw1-p1). ML infra + hosted gen routes will see a transient bump for ~5-15m depending on backfill.

devon: schedule ok for 12:15. i'll run the cordon/drain script and watch evictions. command i'll use:
```
for n in $(cat nodes-to-reshard.txt); do 
  kubectl cordon $n && kubectl drain $n --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60; 
  sleep 30; 
  kubectl uncordon $n; 
done
```

lee: what about KV cache cold-start cost? if we push traffic off, models will re-seed and inflate token cost for a short time. estimate +3-5% tokens for the hour. finance aware?

alex: yep noted. cost hit small — approximate additional GPU-hours: 2-3 GPU-hours at worst for backfill/priming. opt team ok with that?

sam: can we stage warm priming to a spare cohort before we move tenants? avoids cold kv cache blowout.

devon: good call. i'll spin a tiny warm cohort (2 nodes) in advance and pre-seed common prefixes from recent traces. should shave priming token delta.

ops-oncall: i'll be on-call and watching network metrics. if packet drops >0.5% or BGP flaps show, i'll pause.

sre-bot: monitor link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/hot-rack-12?orgId=1 : alert set for nvlink errors > 3/min

marie: ETA to finish whole pool?

alex: expected finish ~12:50 if no retries. i'll post updates per node.

lee: quick rollback plan?

alex: rollback = stop script, re-route prod traffic to pool-gpu-usw1-p2 + revert any early uncordons. if we see customer error rate > 0.3% we auto-rollback.

sam: thumbs for warm pre-seed. pls post the node list once you have it.

devon: nodes-to-reshard.txt uploaded to shared ops bucket and pinned in thread. starting verifications now.

alex: thanks — i'll kick at 12:15. will ping here every 2 nodes. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: ack, will hold incident bridge open for 30m post-run.

marie: +1

lee: +1

alex: 12:16 — node-3 cordoned, eviction in progress (expected 7m)

alex: 12:24 — node-3 uncordoned, latency stable. moving to node-7

alex: 12:34 — node-7 had a bad pod (oom) during eviction, fixed by restarting sidecar and resumed; overall pool capacity healthy

alex: 12:48 — final node uncordoned, pool reshard complete. thermal on rack-12 trending down; nvlink error rate back to baseline.

ops-oncall: metrics look green. closing bridge.

sam: nice run. will follow-up with exact token cost delta in the billback doc.
